name: 10B Human Needs Tree
description: Categories of human need for the 10B model — combining Maslow's hierarchy, Max-Neef's fundamental human needs, the UN Sustainable Development Goals, and the structural categories of the CIA World Factbook. Each category groups country-level indicators into a satisfaction score with provenance, propagating into a country-level rollup model and a cross-country category rollup. The tree is the supervisory schema for the embedding model that captures the human needs of a population.
lineage: Max-Neef (1991) — Fundamental human needs and the matrix of satisfiers
Doyal & Gough (1991) — A Theory of Human Need (basic + intermediate needs)
